sun.security.ssl

接口 KrbClientKeyExchangeHelper

  • 所有已知实现类:
    KrbClientKeyExchangeHelperImpl

    public interface KrbClientKeyExchangeHelper
    Helper interface for KrbClientKeyExchange SSL classes to access the Kerberos implementation without static-linking. This enables Java SE Embedded 8 compilation using 'compact1' profile -where SSL classes are available but Kerberos are not-.
